notes: v1.14.557 — THE RACK COMES BACK AFTER THE AISLE. Reach a rack detail from anywhere Build's 3D preview never mounted — the deep-link or back-nav restore, which calls deploy_showRackDetail from wherever the operator is — then tap OPEN AISLE and close it, and the rack elevation was GONE. A 51px control rail over an empty box: exactly the condition v1.14.531 shipped to remove. ⛔ HOW IT CAME BACK: .531 (Ship A) deleted #reh3dMount and the reh3d_restore() call inside deploy_showRackDetail, but reh3d_activate3D has a SECOND caller — forge3d_close's no-lender branch — that Ship A did not audit. forge3d_open captures its lender from RackEngine.active(); after .531 the rack detail registers nothing, because rackElevation_render3D is the only non-aisle registrar and this page no longer calls it. Opened from Build a lender exists and close hands the context back, so it looks fine; opened from Home there is no lender, close falls through to reh3d_activate3D, and that function added .is-3d BEFORE looking for the mount. :11119 hides #rehFlatWrap on .is-3d — since .531 the only rack visual on the page — the mount lookup then returned null, and nothing removes the class again. ⭐ .531's OWN COMMIT MESSAGE PREDICTED THIS EXACT FAILURE for the wrong fix. It removed the caller it could see. THE FIX IS THE ORDER: resolve #reh3dMount first and return if it is absent, so no caller — present or future — can put the host into .is-3d with nothing to draw into. The mount check sits ahead of the WebGL probe on purpose: warning 'WebGL unavailable' when the real cause is an absent mount names the wrong reason. ⚠ WHY IT HID: nothing throws anywhere on the path, and the .461 instrument measures the OPS host, which survives at 51px — above its 8px floor — so no warning and no toast fired while the rack itself sat at 0px. It also self-heals on any re-render, so it presented as intermittent. Reproduced and fixed under 47-rack-detail-aisle-return, 4 tests, mutation-proven: reverting the guard fails two and leaves the two control tests passing. The regression test measures #rackCanvas, never #rehFlatWrap — the wrapper is display:contents (:11117) and has no box of its own, which reported a false zero on the first probe run.
